asked.item: Carousel made via n8n not visible in the app

verdict.reason: The FAQ says all generated visuals, including carousels made in n8n, are saved at Videos, and gives a direct link to look for recent creations.

steps.text: Carousels you generate are saved at Videos, including ones created in n8n.
If you can't find it, go directly to my.blotato.com/videos and look for your recent creations there.
